news.content: Our group has **four papers** accepted for presentation at [CIST 2026](https://cist2026.github.io/). Congratulations, Suhyeon, Juneha, Jaehyeong, and Gaon!
Our group has **two papers** accepted to Findings of [EMNLP 2026](https://2026.emnlp.org/). Congratulations, Juneha, Suhyeon, and Jaehyeong!

Our group will participate in a collaborative research consortium with [TradLinx](https://www.tradlinx.com/) and [Pusan National University](https://www.pusan.ac.kr/) to develop the **"Multi-Route Decision Support and AI Agent-Based Integrated SCM Automation Platform for Maritime Logistics"**, supported by the [ScaleUp TIPS](https://scaleuptips.or.kr/) program of the Ministry of SMEs and Startups (funding period: 3 years).

Our paper titled **"When Persona Simulations Are Informative: Graph-Structured Signals for Pluralistic Opinion Sensing"** has been accepted for presentation at [CIKM 2026](https://cikm2026.diag.uniroma1.it/). Congratulations, Taehyeon and Jaehyeong!
Prof. Shin received the Best Reviewer Award at the 2026 KrAIS Summer Workshop.
We have one graduate student joining our group. Welcome aboard, Myungsu!
Congratulations to Taehyeon on being selected for the Hyundai Motor CMK Foundation Scholarship (현대차 정몽구 스칼러십)!
Congratulations to Suhyeon on receiving the NRF PhD Research Fellowship (박사연구장려금) and the KOSAF Doctoral Excellence Scholarship (박사우수장학금)!
Congratulations to Woohyun on receiving the NRF Master's Research Fellowship (석사연구장려금)!
Our project on **"Persona-calibrated LLM Simulations"** has been awarded funding through the NRF Early-career Researcher Program (funding period: 1 year).

Our paper titled **"The 2026 Service Research Priorities: AI-Driven Discovery, Interdisciplinary Influence Dynamics, and the “Interactive Service Scholarship Incubator” for Personalized Priorities"** has been accepted for publication in the [Journal of Service Research](https://doi.org/10.1177/10946705261447646). Congratulations, Juneha!
Prof. Shin has been appointed as an adjunct professor in the [Department of AX](https://ax.kaist.ac.kr/) (AI Transformation) at KAIST College of AI.
Our project on **"Agent-to-Agent Commerce"** has been awarded funding through the KAIST C2 (Creative & Challenging) Project (funding period: 9 months).
Welcome to AIBA Lab's new website! 🎉
Prof. Shin received the 2025 KAIST College of Business Impact Research Award.

Our paper titled "Regulating AI-Generated Content: When Do Restrictions Spark or Stifle Community Dynamics?" (with Jane Shin and Suhyeon Lee) received the **Best Paper Award** (오재인 최우수논문상) at the 2025 KMIS International Conference.
Our group has **two papers** accepted for presentation at [WITS 2025](https://witsconf.org/). Congratulations, Taehyeon!

Our paper titled **"Regulating AI-Generated Content: When Do Restrictions Spark or Stifle Community Dynamics?"** has been accepted for presentation at [WISE 2025](https://sites.google.com/view/wise2025). Congratulations, Suhyeon!
Our group has **two papers** accepted for presentation at [CIST 2025](https://sites.google.com/view/cist2025). Congratulations, Youngjun!

Our paper titled **"PlaceSim: An LLM-based Interactive Platform for Human Behavior Simulation in Physical Facilities"** has been accepted for presentation at [CIKM 2025](https://cikm2025.org/). Congratulations, Suhyeon and Youngjun!
AIBA Lab has officially launched!
